founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Serial entrepreneur based in Argentina. Founder & CEO of HENRY. Previously co-founded Nubi (exit), a cross-border payments fintech that partnered with PayPal and TransferWise and was later acquired by Comafi Bank. Also co-founded VerdeAgua (exit), the largest hydroponic company in Uruguay, acquired by IBF Group.
